Her upper torso stays narrower; a sharply defined waist flows into a pronounced high-hip shelf, broad rounded hips, and visibly fuller upper thighs. Her facial appearance—face shape, features, complexion, hairline, and hairstyle—takes its cue only from the attached image. In ankle-deep water, the conservator draws a low-pressure suction wand along one loosened tessera seam to remove flood silt. Wet geometric mosaics, brass arches, loose tesserae, abstract unlettered condition markers, and rippling cool-and-warm work-light reflections make the emergency conservation action credible.
